Keyed by date. 'was' is the plan's own words for that day: if the plan changes, the importer keeps the plan's words for that day and lists it, so this file can be updated.

start._about: Jason, 22 October 2026: 'Pull everything ahead and start from tomorrow.' Study days from 'from' up to the first holiday move into the study days starting 'on', one after another; the study day left over just before the holiday becomes a spare day. Days off, and every week after the first holiday, keep their dates. Earlier study days are dropped.

today.title: Set up your notes
today.task: Set up the study notes app, write a practice note from any section of the exam guide, and configure commands like infra, wflow and code within the markdown.

spare.title: Spare day
spare.task: Nothing new. Rest, or catch up on anything you missed.

stretch._about: Jason, 2 November 2026: 'I am struggling to find time to study for this. Push the exam date to May 2027 please. Adjust study times accordingly.' Everything not yet done (from 'resume') is spread out from 'on' to the day before 'exam'. Holidays and Christmas keep their dates. Study days are Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Sunday for 30-minute sessions, Wednesday for half-days and Saturday for the 2-hour block, so most weeks have Wednesday and Friday off. The last five days before the exam keep the plan's taper. Days between 'resume' and 'on' that were never studied become moved days.

rest.title: Day off
rest.task: No studying today. Catch up on a missed day if you want to.

moved.title: Moved to later
moved.task: This day's work moved when the exam moved to May.
